Za.bar_b_note: The elder villager is clean, warm and readable (olive vest, sage scarf, leather boots fit the Meadows palette), but the glossy oversized-eye cartoon face sits closer to a toy/animated-film look than the naturalistic finish of the owner bar, and the neutral stage carries no light or atmosphere.

Mj.bar_b_note: Side A's shaggy fur gets closest to the owner's naturalistic bar but is broken up by noisy yellow blotches and floats off the floor in faint mid; side B's smooth terracotta clay body with stuck-on moss reads as a piggy-bank toy, well below Palworld creature finish.

Yf.bar_b_note: Smeared, low-resolution ground blends, a flat tiled stronghold wall and a hazeless flat sky sink it; side A's cleared camps and smoke column give some aftermath story, but nothing has Valheim-class light or Palworld-class density.

Us.bar_b_note: The deep blue-grey translucent panel with teal selection is on-brief and tidy, but tiny orange material lines, a large empty centre column and a small subject icon keep it below a shipping HUD's at-a-glance hierarchy on a 7-inch screen.

Ce.bar_b_note: Side A's crystalline violet-and-white wolf matches the owner's Tanglevolt bar and its rearing hit react reads instantly, but side B's faint frames swap to a white-and-black blotched material that looks like a missing texture, which would never pass in a shipping game.

top_changes.change: Rework Meadows ground and wall materials plus the sky/atmosphere grade: replace the smeared low-res grass/dirt blend and flat tiled stronghold wall with crisp, value-varied terrain materials, add grass clumps and groves instead of carpet, and add warm sun/cool blue distance haze so aftermath sites read as the key art's world (Yf all rows).

Fix creature state materials and grounding: keep Tanglevolt's violet fur material through faint mid/end (Ce B shows a white/black blotch swap), keep faint poses on the floor (Mj A faint mid floats above its shadow), and give hit reacts a visible change from standing (Ce B).

Rebuild the Meadows boar (Mj) to the owner's naturalistic style bar: real bristled brown fur with moss growth as on the creature colour board, a clear face and eyes, and enough height to stand clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, replacing both the blotchy-fur and clay-toy versions.
